response.courseDescription: 265 Measurement of Radioactive Materials Handling, characterization, and analysis of radioactive materials including nuclear theory and physics, radiation safety and detectors, alpha and gamma spectrometry, separation and analysis of radionuclides, and nuclear forensics. Cooperative: Open to UI degree-seeking students.
response.coursePrerequisites: CHEM 161; concurrent enrollment in either CHEM 101 or CHEM 105.
